methodology.inference: Algebraic attribution is descriptive, not out-of-sample causal evidence. No uncertainty estimate treats 57000 draws as independent historical observations.
methodology.pairing: Unbiased orientation yields exact uniform-row marginal. Stored-pair orientation averaging isolates finite orientation variation; does not estimate joint counterfactuals.
methodology.pool: Exact finite-population moments, no RNG. Full bank is descriptive reference containing ineligible rows, never supplied to temporal selector.
methodology.residual: Native additive residual for plays/TDs. For attempts/carries/yards, effective raw primitive minus deterministic primitive center; bank values at original bank centers, sampled values at target centers. Not interchangeable native residual parameters.
methodology.transformations: raw continuous equations -> constraints -> opportunity rounding -> final rounding; variance shifts depend on this declared ordering.

pairing.explanation: Uniform pair plus unbiased A/B orientation gives uniform team-row marginal; pair correlation affects joint outcomes, not marginal expectation. Balance uses stored pairs only.

tails.note: Centered second-moment contributions, not effects of removing tails.
